senses.definition: Any of many heathers, of the genus Erica, used as garden plants

quotes.text: I have now arrived at the third year since the ericas were seedlings and cuttings; and, as much can be said in this stage of their growth applicable to future years, it is my intention to do so.
quotes.reference: 1840, John Claudius Loudon, The Gardener's Magazine and Register of Rural & Domestic Improvement:
